gp.heading: Gross Margin
gp.text: Gross margin (Net sales less Manufacturing cost of sales as a percentage of Net sales) decreased 2,100 basis points from 52.8% for the three months ended September 30, 2025 to 31.8% for the three months ended September 30, 2026 reflecting changes in product and pricing mix associated volume-based pricing extended to a single customer in connection with increased order volume as well as higher inventory reserves associated with increased inventory levels.

cor.text: Gross margin (Net sales less Manufacturing cost of sales as a percentage of Net sales) decreased 2,100 basis points from 52.8% for the three months ended September 30, 2025 to 31.8% for the three months ended September 30, 2026 reflecting changes in product and pricing mix associated volume-based pricing extended to a single customer in connection with increased order volume as well as higher inventory reserves associated with increased inventory levels.

pretax.heading: Income Before Income Taxes
pretax.text:
Income before income taxes decreased $7, or 5.4%, from $129 for the three months ended September 30, 2025 to $122 for the three months ended September 30, 2026. The decrease was primarily due to a $24, or 16.6%, increase in Engineering, selling and administrative driven by higher corporate-level expenses allocated to the Merchant Investment segment.

The decrease was partially offset by a $17, or 6.2%, increase in Net investment income. The increase was driven by accrued interest earned on the Skyline Note partially offset by lower yields on investments in United States Treasury money market funds.

intro.text: The LGL Group, Inc. ("LGL," "LGL Group," or the "Company") is a holding company engaged in services, merchant investment and manufacturing business activities. Precise Time and Frequency, LLC ("PTF") is a globally positioned producer of industrial Electronic Instruments and commercial products and services. Founded in 2002, PTF operates from our design and manufacturing facility in Wakefield, Massachusetts. Lynch Capital International LLC is focused on the development of value through investments. LGL Group was incorporated in 1928 under the laws of the State of Indiana, and in 2007, the Company was reincorporated under the laws of the State of Delaware as The LGL Group, Inc. We maintain our executive offices at 2525 Shader Road, Orlando, Florida 32804. Our telephone number is (202) 780-5941. Our Internet address is www.lglgroup.com.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Short-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for the cash they will return: financial.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Inventory
lines.why: Goods held for sale: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Goodwill
lines.why: Paid for acquired businesses: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Deferred tax assets
lines.why: Taxes on operating income paid ahead: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current assets
lines.why: Other long-term operating items: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued compensation
lines.why: Wages, bonuses and benefits earned but not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Income taxes payable
lines.why: Taxes on operating income: operating.

lines.name: Other current liabilities
lines.why: Other operating items due within a year: operating.

lines.name: Long-term debt
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

s.t: Because we consolidate Skyline SPV as a variable interest entity, the full carrying amount of Skyline SPV's investment is reflected on our Condensed Consolidated Balance Sheets, and our maximum exposure to loss is the the carrying amount of the Skyline Note and related accrued interest.

Through our wholly owned subsidiary, Lynch Capital International, LLC, we invested $850 in Skyline Instruments May 2026, a Series of CGF2021 LLC (the "Skyline SPV"), a pooled investment vehicle that holds a note receivable from Skyline Instruments Corporation ("Skyline"), an early-stage company developing precision timing and GPS-denied sensing technologies.

Although this interest is less than a majority, the Company is the primary beneficiary of Skyline SPV and consolidates it because it has (i) the power to direct the activities that most significantly affect Skyline SPV’s economic performance, through Lynch Capital’s role as investment advisor with exclusive authority over decisions to convert, dispose of or otherwise manage the Skyline Note, and (ii) variable interests, consisting of its equity interest, a management fee payable before investor distributions, and carried interest, that give it the obligation to absorb losses of, or the right to receive benefits from, Skyline SPV that could potentially be significant to it.
Lynch Capital serves as investment advisor to Skyline SPV pursuant to an investment advisory agreement (the "Skyline IAA").
Through its investment in Skyline SPV, the Company holds a variable interest in Skyline in the form of the Skyline Note and related contractual rights.

As described in Note 1 - Overview and Basis of Presentation, Lynch Capital serves as investment advisor to Skyline SPV under the Skyline IAA, with authority over all decisions regarding its assets, including the management, conversion and disposition of the Skyline Note.

Our investment associated with Skyline Instruments Corporation ("Skyline") is held through Skyline Instruments May 2026, a Series of CGF2021 LLC ("Skyline SPV"), a consolidated investment vehicle that owns a convertible promissory note issued by Skyline (the "Skyline Note").
There is no public market for the securities of Skyline or for interests in Skyline SPV, and we may be unable to dispose of our interest or recover our investment when we wish to do so, or at all.
